1060-progress.name: Witch Doctor Jin'Zil
1060-progress.text: You seem a shady character. You have something for me to see?
1060-progress.title: Letter to Jin'Zil

1069-progress.name: Mebok Mizzyrix
1069-progress.text: Did you get the eggs, $N?  I already made a shipping deal with Wharfmaster Dizzywig!
1069-progress.title: Deepmoss Spider Eggs

1824-progress.name: Ruga Ragetotem
1824-progress.text: Do you have the antennae?  If so then give them to me quickly, for twitching antennae do not twitch forever...
1824-progress.title: Trial at the Field of Giants

3369-progress.name: Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem
3369-progress.text: May I help you with something?
3369-progress.title: In Nightmares

3921-progress.name: Wenikee Boltbucket
3921-progress.text: I'm very busy with my work, $c.  Unless you have something for me, it'd be best if you moved along...
3921-progress.title: Wenikee Boltbucket

3922-progress.name: Wenikee Boltbucket
3922-progress.text: Do you have the nugget slugs, $N?  I've been eyeing this Samophlange and I can't wait to tinker with it.
3922-progress.title: Nugget Slugs

3923-progress.name: Rilli Greasygob
3923-progress.text: Mind your head!  I don't want it to get in the way of my work!
3923-progress.title: Rilli Greasygob

5042-progress.name: Mangletooth
5042-progress.text:
I will need 4 blood shards if you wish Agamaggan's strength, $r.

Your foes will cower before your strength were you to be given this blessing. <snort>

The Razormane's greatest warriors are infused with such power!
5042-progress.title: Agamaggan's Strength

5043-progress.name: Mangletooth
5043-progress.text:
My tribes greatest scouts are said to be unrivaled in their accuracy, and no rogue <snort> could measure up to their quickness in battle.

Bring me 4 blood shards and I will make you even more agile than any quilboar born.
5043-progress.title: Agamaggan's Agility

5046-progress.name: Mangletooth
5046-progress.text:
All those who <snort> enter battle have need of protection. Their bones must be strong. Their skin tough. <snort> My tribe knows this as well, and to add to the natural protection our quills and hide give us, <snort> we often call upon Agamaggan to protect us from harm before we go to war.

Bring me 4 blood shards <snort> and I will grant you the same protection.
5046-progress.title: Razorhide

5052-progress.name: Mangletooth
5052-progress.text:
Our tribes flock to the thorny areas throughout the Barrens <snort> because they are holy places, but none as holy as Razorfen. Agamaggan's body makes up the entirety of the Razorfen, <snort> but the Downs are especially protected because the entrance is made from his great maw! <snort> It will swallow whole those not loyal to him, and spit out their bodies after he's chewed them up! <snort>

Agamaggan has left his body behind to protect us, and he gives of his spirit so we may protect him. <snort>
5052-progress.title: Blood Shards of Agamaggan

6284-progress.name: Maggran Earthbinder
6284-progress.text: Besseleth is a ruthless predator... I fear for those that travel Webwinder Path at night. It's then that she and her children prey upon innocent travelers. I myself fell prey to her two-foot fang of death, but luckily I was able to fend her off and get to safety. I would give anything to see that monster destroyed.
6284-progress.title: Arachnophobia

6981-progress.name: Falla Sagewind
6981-progress.text: Hello, $r. What can I do for you?
6981-progress.title: The Glowing Shard

858-progress.name: Wizzlecrank's Shredder
858-progress.text: Quick, we need to get out of here before someone gets suspicious!
858-progress.title: Ignition

876-progress.name: Darsok Swiftdagger
876-progress.text: You're not getting anything until I see Serena's head.
876-progress.title: Serena Bloodfeather

889-progress.name: Mangletooth
889-progress.text:
Bring Mangletooth 10 blood shards and I will bless you with great speed. You will run with zhevra and the wind will be jealous of you.

It will not last long, but it should be enough to help you travel throughout the Barrens.
889-progress.title: Spirit of the Wind

891-progress.name: Captain Thalo'thas Brightsun
891-progress.text: My fleet is in peril with Captain Fairmount and her damned cannoneers blasting away from Northwatch Hold. I want her soldiers to pay as well. Fill my hand with medals from their dead and I will know that vengeance has been given to my fallen privateers.
891-progress.title: The Guns of Northwatch

899-progress.name: Mankrik
899-progress.text: The quilboar will pay for this, $N. I swear it.
899-progress.title: Consumed by Hatred

91899-complete.name: Dokimi
91899-complete.text:
Thank you for your hard work, $N. There has been an uprising in bandits and thieves intercepting trade routes as of late. If you find other crates lying around, please bring them here and we'll handle the rest.

Here is your payment.
91899-complete.title: A Sealed Crate

91899-progress.name: Dokimi
91899-progress.text: Another delivery! Fantastic. Set it over by the pile and we can discuss your compensation.
91899-progress.title: A Sealed Crate

92706-progress.name: Gazlowe
92706-progress.text: What can I do for ya, $r?
92706-progress.title: WANTED: Bruuz

95774-complete.name: Mankrik
95774-complete.text:
I will place these adornments with my wife's memorial, so that I never forget her. My blood will always run hot with revenge!

You have done me... done us... a great favor, $N.
95774-complete.title: Her Name Is Olgra

95774-progress.name: Mankrik
95774-progress.text: I have only memories now, but I will build a tribute to Olgra so that they never fade.
95774-progress.title: Her Name Is Olgra

97003-complete.name: Gur'ak
97003-complete.text:
Impressive, $c. None will doubt my tales when I return to Orgrimmar with this grim proof of the existence of these abominations. Rest assured this glory is yours however, and I will speak loudly of your deeds.

Lok-tar!
97003-complete.title: Chol'aruk the Ravener

97003-progress.name: Gur'ak
97003-progress.text:
It took the strength of six skilled fighters to defeat one of these creatures, and it still managed to fell four of us before we could put it down.

If these monstrous beasts were to appear in greater numbers, the damage that the quilboar could inflict upon the land could be catastrophic.
97003-progress.title: Chol'aruk the Ravener

97253-complete.name: Wrenix the Wretched
97253-complete.text:
Whooooa! Nice one, pal! You saved me from another one of Gagsprocket's unbearable lectures on the cost of metal. More importantly, I can jump right into building my next prototype.

Uhhh, I didn't have a reward planned... Do you like boxes?
97253-complete.title: Parts and Pieces

97253-progress.name: Wrenix the Wretched
97253-progress.text: Not another word out of you until your pockets are jingling with metal!
97253-progress.title: Parts and Pieces

98248-complete.name: Dokimi
98248-complete.text:
You found the right place, and you're speaking with the right person! I can jot you down as one of our new associates. No paperwork necessary on your part, I can't be bothered with more of that.

All we ask of you is to assist in dealing with compromised deliveries you find during your travels. Doing so will earn you Merchant's Favor, which you can use to purchase goods and services right here. Here's a bit to get you settled in!

Do you happen to have the crate this label came with?
98248-complete.title: Shipping Label

98248-progress.name: Dokimi
98248-progress.text: Good day, traveler. How can I assist?
98248-progress.title: Shipping Label
